message: カバディカバディ
After school, I came to Prier.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa, you came here too.」
I ran right into Misa at the entrance of Prier.

name: Misa
message: 「If you're looking for Pasta-san, she's not here, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
Complaints about Pasta have been sent to the Student Council, and the number of letters in the suggestion box is increasing day by day.

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san apparently has no intention of reprimanding Pasta, but... I should at least keep tabs on what she's up to.」

name: Synn
message: 「You had the same idea, didn't you, Misa? If you'd just said something, I would've come with you.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-I-I refuse! Who would ever get tea with you, Sakura-kun--」

name: Synn
message: 「Good point. If the Student Council President and Vice President showed up together to inspect things, it'd put Pasta on guard.」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right! That's what I was thinking too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still... *sigh*, I was hoping I might get the jump on you, Sakura-kun, so this turned out to be a wasted trip.」

name: Misa
message: 「See you later, I'm heading off now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
I took half a step to the right to clear the way for Misa.
...However, because Misa moved in the exact same direction, I ended up blocking her path instead.

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm going now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mgh-mgh...」
I took half a step to the left to clear the way for Misa.
...However, because Misa moved in the exact same direction, I ended up blocking her path instead.

name: Misa
message: 「Mgh-mgh-mgh...」
I stepped to the left. Misa went the exact same way yet again.

name: Misa
message: 「What's the big idea?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I don't have any ulterior motive. I just want to let you pass, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I will not accept your charity, Sakura-kun! If you're serious about yielding to me, then hand over the student council president's seat!」

name: Synn
message: 「How did the conversation jump all the way to that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Classic Synn-sama. Working out with side-to-side jumps--your health regimen's totally on point, ain't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff, huff... So you're determined to get in my way no matter what? How insolent!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, you're wrong. This is just an unfortunate accident caused by a bunch of coincidences.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Syncing up your moves this closely is kinda miraculous in its own way.」

name: Misa
message: 「Very well. It's a match, Sakura-kun! I will surpass you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, I have no intention of doing that. Listen closely, Misa? I'm going to step to the left, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun goes left, then I go right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that'll make everything go smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... i-it happened again.」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrrraaah! You tricked me, didn't you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a misunderstanding. Since we're facing each other, our left and right are reversed, so the hand you hold your chopsticks with--」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun is chopsticks, then I am a fork!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-Idiots. There're two total idiots right here...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it. I'm not moving anymore.」

name: Misa
message: 「You should have done that from the very beginning! Now then, for real this time, good day!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hagyuuu~~...!」
Misa crashes straight into Prier's glass door and crouches down on the spot.
The single pane of glass has been polished so thoroughly that it is transparent enough to be virtually invisible.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Ow... It doesn't hurt at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!? I-I'm being targeted...? A Demon is launching a personal attack against me...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter how you look at it, that was totally self-inflicted, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggggh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up! I just let my guard down a little because I'm short on sleep!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lack of sleep?」

name: Synn
message: 「If there's anything I can help out with for Student Council work, feel free to toss it my way, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I can at least handle my duties as vice president.」

name: Synn
message: 「...So stubborn. *Mutter*」

name: Synn
message: 「At least, that's what Paqy said.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I didn't say that!!」
Leaving Prier behind, I walk Misa to the church.
Days packed with Student Council work. Her duties as a Crusader. Of course, she doesn't neglect her studies either. And on top of all that, Misa belongs to a school club.
Captain of the choir--
If you're working that hard at so many different things, of course you're going to lose sleep...

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... fuh... mm... ngh...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I was not yawning, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, I didn't even ask.」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything, what I want to know is why you let me walk you here without putting up a fight... I guess?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know I'm the one who offered, but I figured you'd turn me down when I asked to escort you to the church.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I'm someone who can properly separate emotion from reason, you know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look who's talking. Aren't you always wearing your emotions on your sleeve and picking fights with Synn-sama?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-th-th-th-that's Sakura-kun's fault!」
Did I ever do anything to make Misa hold a grudge against me...?

name: Misa
message: 「When it comes to choir activities, though, that's a different story.」

name: Misa
message: 「Look, this is a mission school, right? At events like the entrance ceremony and graduation, the choir takes the lead in singing the hymns.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, when I first saw the choir at the entrance ceremony, I was blown away.」

name: Misa
message: 「I was impressed too, thinking how amazing it was.」

name: Misa
message: 「But... heh-heh, the Holy Night Festival choir is waaaay more wonderful, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're practically the stars of the show celebrating Christmas... That's why I have to value our practice time.」

name: Misa
message: 「As the leader, I can't afford to fail. Being in poor health is just an excuse for failing to manage oneself.」

name: Misa
message: 「Therefore, Sakura-kun. Escort me safely to the chapel!!」

name: Synn
message: 「As you command. I am humbly honored to play the knight.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-wh-wh-what are you saying? You're like Attendant Number Three at best.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like the choir kids aren't here yet.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nod, nod...」
Whoa, Misa's totally nodding off...

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that we're here, she probably let her guard down, yeah?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forcing herself to stay sharp and awake outside where people could see--that's classic Hiss for ya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nod, nod... *jerk!* Mm-mm? Ah, nod, nod...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody's around, so take a quick nap.」
I try to guide Misa over to a pew, but

name: Misa
message: 「Nod, nod... mm... nn, shake-shake-shake.」
Despite being practically fast asleep, she stubbornly refused.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa... I'll take full responsibility and wake you up before the choir kids get here, so rest easy and sleep.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nod, nod... mm, nn...」

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's already out cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh! Keep it down, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz...」
Huh... Misa's sleeping face is--
No, no! Studying a girl's sleeping face is just in bad taste!
I turn my back on Misa and spend a little while looking around the church.
The sunlight filtering through the stained glass is pleasantly warm, so there's no need to worry about Misa catching a chill while she sleeps.
Oh? What's that picture frame...?
Looking closely, paintings and photographs are hung near the entrance of the chapel.
Villagers gathering at Christmas to celebrate the festival. Next to it is a snapshot taken at last year's Holy Night Festival. A large crowd of choir members.
Misa is in the photo...
It was only a year ago, yet the Misa in the photo looks so much younger...
This year, Misa is the leader. She's conducting a choir of dozens of people.
She's way more impressive than me, getting overwhelmed by a Student Council of just five people.

name: Misa
message: 「Suu, suu... Mmm... Bear...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy, girls aren't supposed to let their stomachs get cold, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, I swore my chastity to Ria-chan, y'know... Still, if it's an order from Synn-sama, I got no choice.」
There is a soft rustling sound as Paqy snuggles up against the sleeping Misa's belly.
With my back still turned, I let my imagination wander.
A little child given their own bedroom, sleeping apart from their parents.
It's their first time alone in bed, yet they aren't lonely because they have a stuffed animal right there in their arms.
...Ahahaha, if Misa ever found out I was picturing her like that, she'd chew me out good.

name: Misa
message: 「Suu, suu, suu... Mgyuuu~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gueeeh~! M-My guts are gonna pop out, my innards are gonna spill out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Swallow them back down.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Th-That's an unprecedentedly cruel order! Expect nothing less from Synn-sama, gugeh!」
